verdict.rationale: Pricing stability is a fair question for a commercial game engine, but the pack shows no stability track record: Unity's own blog post about canceling the Runtime Fee confirms that a fee was introduced and then reversed. Community reports describe a per-install fee on shipped games, unilateral forced license upgrades that doubled costs, and complaints that terms can change at any moment. There is no first-party commitment against retroactive repricing, so the story is not delivered.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the pricing and license terms have a track record of stability — no retroactive changes that reprice games already shipped
